verdict.rationale: monday.com documents creating custom dashboard widgets, though through its developer apps framework. It also claims automated scheduled status and performance reports, and spotting progress gaps. No evidence shows a native, no-code dashboard builder a product manager could use directly for project-progress reporting. Missing for 10: first-party docs on native dashboard creation and built-in widget types for project progress, documentation of a non-developer PM workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps.
Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
Spot risks and progress gaps before they become problems.
